title: Another child dies of measles as CDC reportedly holds up health alert
gist: A child in New York died of measles, the state's first measles death in more than 30 years and the seventh US measles death this year. The CDC reports more than 4,850 cases, the most since 1991. The article ties the outbreak to falling vaccination and to HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., whose CDC reportedly blocked a health alert on measles in pregnancy and changed how deaths are counted.

insights.so_what: Rising outbreaks of vaccine-preventable disease put pressure on health systems and public-health budgets.
